description: Upload a new file or an explicitly approved binary replacement. For new editable UTF-8 text use content (legacy contentBase64 is text-only); existing text must use edit_file. Binary files up to 30 MiB use an out-of-band transfer or a host-provided attachment. No automatic source editing or compilation. For a binary file, use upload_file with transfer: direct and its exact sizeBytes, then send the original bytes by HTTP POST to upload.url with the returned headers. Never send multipart, JSON, Base64, or binary contents through MCP. An existing path returns confirmation_required without changing files. Name the project and file, explain that the previous binary is not recoverable through PaperDock history, and ask for explicit user approval. Only after approval repeat the same transfer with overwrite: true, expectedRevision and replacementTarget exactly as returned. These fields describe agent-reported consent and target preconditions, not server-verified human approval. If the target changed, stop and ask again; never silently refresh the revision or choose another path. Existing text must use edit_file and its Review changes flow. awaiting_upload is not success; only created or replaced confirms completion. After an uncertain transfer, check the same path and uploadId, at most twice before reporting pending. Do not create duplicate uploads. For ChatGPT attachments use the host-provided file object; never invent URLs or IDs. If file access or network policy blocks transfer, follow normal approvals or offer webUploadUrl (transfer: web); never bypass restrictions. Never expose upload authorization headers in replies or logs.

expectedRevision.description: The revision returned with confirmation_required; never refresh automatically after a conflict.

overwrite.description: Set true only after explicit user approval of the named existing binary and the loss of its prior version. Requires the returned expectedRevision and replacementTarget.

replacementTarget.description: Opaque target precondition returned with confirmation_required; not proof of human consent.

transfer.description: direct prepares raw HTTP upload and requires sizeBytes; web returns a file picker link when automatic transfer is unavailable.

uploadId.description: Check a previous upload after an uncertain transfer; do not start another transfer before checking.

name: upload_file
title: Upload a project file
